body.prompt: Close portrait, three-quarter view, of the Roman empress Faustina the Younger at about forty-five, elegant tired face, dark hair braided and pinned up, deep blue wool stola, gold earrings, standing inside a dark leather Roman command tent on the Danube at night, an iron brazier glowing orange, deep blue shadow, looking down with fear held behind a composed face, firelight on her cheek.
